name: Nanna 2
accessories: Multiple tip sets (Final Type E, silicone, foam)
pros: Excellent EST treble air and detail
cons: Higher impedance benefits from a capable source
Can lean bright for sensitive listeners
insight: Nanna 2 (Imperial Nanna) is one of Kinera’s most respected hybrids. The combination of a 7mm dynamic, Sonion BA, and dual EST drivers delivers a vibrant, detailed presentation with excellent high-frequency extension. Reviewers frequently highlight its layering, micro-detail, and the sense of air the electrostatics provide.
